title: Context without giant prompts
intro: Give the agent the page around the prompt.

sections.title: A local context document
sections.body: Avocado compiles the context for a turn into a local Markdown document. The agent receives a reference to that context rather than requiring every piece of project information to be repeated inline inside the user prompt.

sections.title: Context you can inspect
sections.body: The result is context that is inspectable by the developer and easier to reason about than an invisible context blob.

sections.title: The project around the request
sections.body: Selected and referenced elements, a bounded page summary, console errors, pins, and supported attachments can help ground the turn. Attachment support depends on the selected backend.

sections.title: External agents
sections.body: Terminal-launched agents can use Avocado's deliberately read-only MCP surface for project and source context. Their normal tools remain responsible for changing the project.
